floorPlans.introduction: Explore the published apartment and townhouse layouts. Where one sheet covers several unit groups, the area range includes every printed total area. Match the unit reference on the complete sheet.
floorPlans.note: The complete Emaar booklet is hosted by property portal Madena. A public official-host download was not verified. These published total areas include the listed balcony or terrace and are not plot areas or current inventory. Confirm the selected unit and final sale plan.
